basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Portland who recently got into electric scooters. I love exploring new gadgets and figuring out how they work. Recently, I started commuting with a scooter and it's been a game-changer for my daily routine. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm a software developer by day and spend weekends kayaking. Currently single, and always looking for new adventures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in software development, which I learned through a computer science degree and years of working in tech startups. My interest in electric scooters is fairly recent, and I'm learning as I go by participating in forums and watching online tutorials.
